pages.heading: A clean that fits the home
sections: Choose a service

Regular cleaning maintains a lived-in home: accessible surfaces, kitchen counters, bathroom fixtures, vacuuming and mopping. Deep cleaning adds more detailed attention to reachable edges, fittings and built-up everyday dirt. Move-out cleaning is for an empty or mostly empty home, with accessible cupboard interiors and a detailed kitchen and bathroom clean. Choose one, two or three bedrooms in the booking form.
Oven cleaning

An oven clean is an optional add-on for any supported service. Select it in the quote so the extra time is included. The booking form is the current authority for prices and duration; this guide does not create a separate price or promise extra services.
Before a time is confirmed

Choose a preferred time and submit the quote for review. A coordinator checks the full job duration and cleaner availability before confirming. Submitting an enquiry does not reserve a cleaner. All services in this demonstration are fictional; no cleaner will attend.

pages.heading: What the clean includes
sections: Floors and carpets

We vacuum accessible carpets and rugs, then mop suitable hard floors. Carpet shampooing, steam extraction and upholstery treatment are not offered. Please move small belongings from the floor before the visit; cleaners do not move heavy furniture to reach hidden areas.
Our cleaning method

We start with a walkthrough of accessible areas, work from higher reachable surfaces down to lower surfaces, clean the kitchen and bathrooms, and finish with vacuuming and mopping. Separate cloths are used for bathroom and kitchen areas. A final walkthrough checks the agreed rooms; it is not a landlord inspection or a deposit guarantee.
Supplies and equipment

Juniper brings ordinary cleaning products, cloths, a vacuum and a mop for the agreed service. Tell the coordinator about delicate surfaces or a preferred product in advance. We cannot promise every requested product will be suitable, and do not make chemical-free, disinfectant or allergy-safe guarantees.

pages.heading: Getting the home ready
sections: Pets

Keep cats, dogs and other pets in a separate safe room away from the areas being cleaned. Tell the coordinator which room they will use before the appointment. Cleaners do not handle pets, and customers remain responsible for their care.
Clear a little space

Put away small valuables, toys and loose items from the surfaces and floors you want cleaned. Leave access to the agreed rooms and identify delicate or damaged items. Heavy furniture, repairs and decluttering are outside the service.
Products and an oven clean

Juniper normally brings supplies and equipment. If you want a particular product used, ask first and provide its label; the coordinator will check suitability. For a booked oven add-on, switch the oven off and let it cool fully, remove food and tell us about faults. Do not dismantle the appliance or mix cleaning products.

pages.heading: Planning access
sections: An agreed way in

Arrange access with the coordinator before the confirmed appointment. You may be present or arrange another agreed access method. Do not put a key code, alarm code or private address into this public demonstration; use fictional details only.
Arrival and availability

The displayed time is in the timezone saved for your demo workspace. A preferred time remains a request until Business review confirms a cleaner. The demo does not dispatch staff or send arrival messages. If an access arrangement changes, request a change for review rather than assuming the calendar has changed.
On the day

Identify the rooms and any restricted areas in advance. Make electricity and water available for the agreed tasks. If safe access is uncertain, the coordinator must review the job; this guide does not authorize entry or guarantee that work can proceed.

pages.heading: When plans change
sections: Request a new time

Use the reschedule control to choose a new preference. The coordinator checks the entire job and cleaner availability again. A confirmed booking keeps its old time until the new time is successfully accepted. A failed change does not release the existing reservation.
Cancel or decline

An awaiting-review request can be declined without a booking. Cancelling a confirmed booking releases that reservation. This demo does not charge a cancellation fee, collect payment or process a refund. No separate cancellation penalty is stated in these guides.
After the clean

Marking a booking completed changes its demonstration status. It does not prove that cleaning took place, payment was collected or a landlord approved the result. Ask the coordinator to review any unsupported request or disputed detail.

pages.heading: Working within the agreed scope
sections: Fragrance and product requests

Tell the coordinator about fragrance preferences and delicate surfaces before booking. Juniper can review a request for an unscented product, but the guides do not guarantee an allergen-free, fragrance-free or chemical-free environment. A cleaner must check the product label and surface suitability; do not mix products.
Work we do not offer

Hazardous materials, biohazards, pest removal, mould remediation, exterior high windows, ladder work, heavy lifting and repairs are excluded. Carpet shampooing and upholstery treatment are also outside the catalogue. Ask for a coordinator review when the condition or task is unclear.
Pause for review

Tell the coordinator about damaged surfaces, access hazards or a task that differs from the request. Do not infer a safety guarantee from a general cleaning guide. The demo provides fictional business guidance and cannot assess a real hazardous situation.

pages.heading: Getting the home ready
sections: Pets

For this revised guide, arrange for cats, dogs and other pets to stay with a trusted person outside the home during the appointment. Tell the coordinator about this arrangement before the visit. Cleaners do not handle pets; customers remain responsible for their care.
Clear a little space

Put away small valuables, toys and loose items from surfaces and floors. Leave access to the agreed rooms and point out delicate or damaged items. Heavy furniture, repairs and decluttering remain outside the service.
Products and an oven clean

Juniper normally brings supplies and equipment. Ask the coordinator before supplying a preferred product. For the oven add-on, switch the appliance off, let it cool fully and remove food. This revision changes preparation guidance only; catalogue prices, duration and existing bookings are unchanged.
